source_admission: Published values used as conventions, constants of a cited reference model, or quoted findings; no external dataset files are admitted. 'access' records what was read for this study on 2026-10-09: the study's source check (a read-only search pass) confirmed each record and read the abstract or the full text named; 'via' marks a source taken from another record in the repository without re-reading it here. No full-text scholarly review has been made.
